title: phaseolus vulgaris var. alboruber
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. alboruber, commonly known as white kidney bean, is a variety of the common bean plant. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include aiding in weight loss and lowering blood sugar levels due to its high content of soluble fiber and polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of white kidney bean include reducing the absorption of starch and sugar in the gut, making it a potential natural remedy for managing diabetes and obesity. The bioactive constituents of Phaseolus vulgaris var. alboruber include alpha-amylase inhibitors, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
